title: 5.10 Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
sub_lesson_title: Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
goal: Use polite requests with quantities and colors at a market and shop; accept or decline an offer.
grammar_function: Can I have three apples, please? Here are your three apples. Do you want a bag? Yes, please. No, thank you. Can I have the blue bag, please? How much is the bag?
prerequisite: 5.9 complete polite ordering sequence; 5.8 named prices; 2.6 quantities; 2.8 colors; 4.8 Do you questions.
speaking_outcome: Request familiar goods at a market and shop and accept or refuse an offered bag politely.

cards.pedagogy_note: Separate second customer: older woman with silver hair, plum blouse, two oranges and her own cream tote declines a paper bag. The first customer accepted; this is not a reversal of her answer.
